title: Use a gate capability on an equal but distinct verifier flow
preconditions: two verifier flows contain equal cloned request data and distinct process-local attempt allocations
steps: obtain valid profile-bearing and session-key-bearing capabilities bound to flow-A
submit each capability to flow-B at its otherwise correct phase
invariants: capability identity uses the exact process-local attempt allocation rather than request equality
wrong-flow profile and session-key capabilities reject before phase claims or request ownership mutate
allocation binding proves exact-flow association rather than cryptographic truth of a capability payload
residual_risk: a trusted producer can put a copied or dishonest payload in a correctly bound capability and remains inside the verifier TCB
